name: Version 0.14.0.0
body:
## Changelog
- Images are now displayed and converted with the correct orientation when Exif orientation data is present
- Fixed a bug when importing TIF files
- Updated Russian translation by @alevtina-karashokova in https://github.com/Faster3ck/Converseen/pull/188
- Various Bugfixes

## New Contributors
* @alevtina-karashokova made their first contribution in https://github.com/Faster3ck/Converseen/pull/188

## Other Changes
- The AppImage version now supports Ubuntu 22.04 and later, as Ubuntu 20.04 has reached end-of-life (EOL).

name: Version 0.13.0.1
body:
## Changelog
- Update French translation (for 0.13.0.0 release) by @david-geiger in https://github.com/Faster3ck/Converseen/pull/186
- Various Bugfixes

## Other changes
- Removed qmake support for AppImage compilation. AppImages are now built using CMake.
- Fixed an issue with loading translations in the AppImage version.
- Resolved a bug with PDF handling in the AppImage version by replacing png16malpha with pngalpha as the ImageMagick delegate for Ghostscript.

- Updated Italian translation
- Various Bugfixes
